$comment: Central model catalogue for all AI-Gateway labs.
When a model is deprecated, change it HERE ONCE - every lab, Bicep template and
Terraform config resolves through this file.
Labs refer to models by ROLE (the keys under 'foundry'/'external'), never by
'lifecycle' mirrors the Azure Cognitive Services regional model catalogue as of
'lifecycleCheckedOn'. It is advisory metadata only - the authoritative check is
utils.validate_model_definitions(), which queries Azure live at deployment time.
2026-09-11 deprecation sweep: every Legacy/Deprecating/Deprecated role was moved to
its GA successor (gpt-4.1* -> gpt-5*, gpt-4o* -> gpt-5*, DeepSeek-R1 ->
DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale). The gpt-5 family is a reasoning family: it rejects
default. Labs were updated to match. The only non-GA roles left are moonshot-*,
where the whole MoonshotAI line is Preview and there is nothing GA to move to.

chat-small.name: gpt-5-mini
chat-small.notes: Default small chat workhorse - by far the most used role. Was gpt-4.1-mini until the 2026-09-11 sweep; gpt-4.1-mini went Legacy.

chat-standard.name: gpt-5
chat-standard.notes: Was gpt-4.1 until the 2026-09-11 sweep; gpt-4.1 went Legacy.

chat-nano.name: gpt-5-nano
chat-nano.notes: Cheapest tier, used for routing demos. Was gpt-4.1-nano until the 2026-09-11 sweep.

chat-4o.name: gpt-5
chat-4o.notes: LEGACY ROLE ALIAS - now identical to chat-standard/chat-flagship. Kept so the cross-region deployment in foundry-e2e-private and the hub-based agent lab keep resolving without edits. Use chat-standard in new labs. Was gpt-4o 2024-11-20 until the 2026-09-11 sweep.

chat-small-4o.name: gpt-5-mini
chat-small-4o.notes: LEGACY ROLE ALIAS - now identical to chat-small/chat-flagship-mini. Use chat-small in new labs. Was gpt-4o-mini 2024-07-18 (Deprecating) until the 2026-09-11 sweep. gpt-5-mini has no regional 'Standard' SKU, so labs that pinned sku='Standard' now take the catalogue GlobalStandard.

chat-frontier.name: gpt-5.2
chat-frontier.notes: Consolidation candidate with chat-frontier-plus / chat-frontier-sol - these three roles differ only by when the lab was written.

router.name: model-router
router.notes: Publisher is OpenAI, NOT Microsoft. Version 2025-05-19 and 2025-08-07 are Preview only; 2025-11-18 is the GA release.

realtime.name: gpt-realtime
realtime.notes: Not offered in uksouth - labs using this role pin a region that offers it (e.g. swedencentral, eastus2).

realtime-mini.name: gpt-realtime-mini
realtime-mini.notes: Not offered in uksouth. A newer 2025-12-15 version is also GA.

deepseek-reasoning.name: DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale
deepseek-reasoning.notes: Reasoning-tuned sibling of deepseek-chat, so the role keeps its meaning. Was DeepSeek-R1 until the 2026-09-11 sweep; R1 and R1-0528 are Deprecated and Azure refuses to deploy them.

slm.name: Phi-4
slm.notes: Versions 2-7 are all GA; 3 is what the labs pin.

moonshot-chat.name: Kimi-K2.6
moonshot-chat.notes: Preview, and deliberately so - every MoonshotAI model in the Azure catalogue is Preview, so there is no GA target to sweep to. utils.validate_model_definitions() rejects non-GA models, so do not add that call to a lab using this role.

moonshot-code.name: Kimi-K2.7-Code
moonshot-code.notes: Version is 2026-06-12. 2026-04-20 belongs to Kimi-K2.6 and does not exist for this model. Preview with no GA target - see moonshot-chat.

external.$comment: Models not deployed through Azure Cognitive Services. Not covered by validate_model_definitions().

aliases.$comment: Literal model name -> role. Used by scripts/check_model_catalog.py to tell contributors which role to use, and accepted by utils.models_config() so a literal name still resolves. Retired literals (gpt-4.1*, gpt-4o*, DeepSeek-R1) are kept on purpose: they still map to the role that replaced them, so old code resolves to the successor instead of failing, and the guard can name the right role in its error message.
